Name: Homewrecker Lance
Author: FreakyBiscuit1
Description:
[left][font=Arial]A fresh hot take on our favorite combat mage from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].[/font][/left]
[left][font=Arial]Featuring beefier muscles, livelier expressions, tattoos, dimples, seasonal outfits, scars, piercings... you get the idea. [/font][/left]
[left][font=Arial]Formatted to work with [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister][font=Arial]Poltergeister's[/font][/url][font=Arial] [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969][font=Arial]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/font][/url][font=Arial], but also works on it's own![/font][/left]
[center][left][font=Arial]HIGHLY recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34318]Lance Dialogue Expansion Pack[/url] for more Lance content![/font][/left]
[/center]
